label: Higgsfield Virality Predictor
description: Higgsfield brain_activity analysis. Predicts hook strength, attention peak, retention risk, and engagement score for a generated video.

video_path.label: Video to Analyze
video_path.description: Path to the video file to run virality analysis on.

hook_score.label: Hook Score (out)
hook_score.description: Read-only. Populated by the analysis result.

attention_peak.label: Attention Peak (s)
attention_peak.description: Read-only. Second in the video where attention is highest.

retention_risk.label: Retention Risk (out)
retention_risk.description: Read-only. Summary of where viewers are likely to drop off.

report_notes.label: Notes
report_notes.description: LLM-written interpretation of the virality report for this shot.

llm_instructions.writing_guide: The virality BONE does not generate content — it analyzes an existing video. When running this BONE: pass the video_path field to the Higgsfield virality_predictor MCP tool or CLI. After the analysis returns, write the results into hook_score, attention_peak, retention_risk, and engagement_score fields on the shot in story.skel. Write a plain-language summary in report_notes explaining what the scores mean for this specific shot and what could improve retention.

field_guides.video_path: Workspace-relative path to the generated video take. Use the active take from the shot's video-map.json entry and resolve it to an absolute path only for the provider call.
field_guides.hook_score: 0–100. Higher is better. Below 40 = weak hook, needs rewrite. 60+ = strong attention grab.
field_guides.attention_peak: Second timestamp. Note in report_notes if the peak aligns with the intended story beat.
field_guides.retention_risk: Plain language. Example: 'Significant drop predicted at 12s — pacing issue after the establishing shot.'
field_guides.report_notes: Write 2–3 sentences: what the scores indicate, which beat is the weakest, and one actionable suggestion for improving retention.

examples.report_notes: Strong hook (72) — the opening statement lands well. Attention peaks at 4s, aligning with the product reveal. Drop predicted at 18s suggests the mid-section loses momentum; consider cutting 3–4 seconds of product b-roll and moving the CTA earlier.

do: Read hook_score, attention_peak, retention_risk, engagement_score from the API response and write them back to the shot
Write report_notes in plain language the director can act on
Reference specific timestamps when noting retention issues
dont: Leave report_notes empty — always write an interpretation
Run virality analysis before a video take exists for the shot
